canonical_statement: The authors report the isolation and characterization of Macrococcus canis from a human specimen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Here, we report the isolation and characterization of M. canis from a human specimen.

canonical_statement: The patient was a 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient with a renal transplant, on dialysis, and with generalized cutaneous maculopapular and impetigo lesions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient, with a renal transplant and on dialysis, presented cutaneous maculopapular and impetigo lesions on the whole body.

population.label: 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient with renal transplant, on dialysis, and diffuse skin lesions

canonical_statement: The patient owned two dogs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient owned two dogs.

population.label: Patient household context: two dogs

canonical_statement: A superficial eSwab was obtained from lesions on the face and arms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A superficial swab (eSwab) was performed from face and arms lesions.

canonical_statement: The superficial lesion swab yielded polymicrobial growth with colonies mainly showing beta-hemolysis after 48 hours on sheep blood agar at 37 °C in 5% CO2.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A polymicrobial growth with colonies mainly showing β-hemolysis was obtained on sheep blood agar plate ... after incubation at 37 °C under a 5% CO2-enriched atmosphere for 48 h.

canonical_statement: Distinct colony morphologies were analyzed by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry using MBT Compass version 4.1 and the MBT 7854 MSP Library.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Each colony exhibiting a different morphology on the plates was selected for identification by matrix-assisted laser desorption ionization-time of flight (MALDI-TOF) mass spectrometry ... MBT compass version 4.1 software and MBT 7854 MSP Library.

canonical_statement: The MBT 7854 MALDI-TOF library identified Acinetobacter ursingii and Enterococcus faecalis in the polymicrobial growth but did not identify the predominant beta-hemolytic colonies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MALDI-TOF MS identified Acinetobacter ursingii and Enterococcus faecalis within the polymicrobial growth, but not the predominant β-hemolytic colonies.

canonical_statement: The predominant beta-hemolytic colonies were evaluated by 16S rRNA gene sequencing because M. canis was absent from the MBT 7854 MSP Library.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: They were identified as M. canis by 16S rRNA gene sequencing as this microorganism did not belong to the MBT 7854 MSP Library of the MALTI-TOF MS.

canonical_statement: 16S rRNA gene sequencing identified the predominant beta-hemolytic colonies as Macrococcus canis, and the updated MBT 8468 MSP library later confirmed that identification.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: They were identified as M. canis by 16S rRNA gene sequencing ... Of note, the updated MBT 8468 MSP library which now contains reference spectra for M. canis confirmed the identification.

canonical_statement: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing used EUST Sensititre microdilution under CLSI standards; MIC interpretation was tentative, using Staphylococcus CLSI breakpoints except EUCAST breakpoints for fusidic acid.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed by microdilution using EUST sensititre plate ... and following the CLSI standards. Interpretation of MIC was tentatively performed using resistance breakpoints recommended for Staphylococcus spp. from CLSI, except for fusidic acid for which breakpoints of EUCAST were used.

canonical_statement: No interpretive breakpoints were available in the source for streptomycin, tiamulin, or mupirocin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: No breakpoints were available for streptomycin, tiamulin, and mupirocin.

canonical_statement: For M. canis strain LI021, the reported Penicillin MIC was >2 mg/L. The source interpreted the isolate as resistant to Penicillin.

canonical_statement: Whole-genome sequencing of LI021 used Illumina NovaSeq short reads and Oxford Nanopore MinION reads with de novo hybrid assembly in Unicycler v0.4.4; SCCmec annotations from NCBI PGAP were manually edited.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The complete 2,216,765 bp circular chromosome of LI021 ... was generated by de novo assembling of Illumina NovaSeq reads and MinION Oxford Nanopore reads using Unicycler software (v0.4.4) ... SCCmec features annotated by the NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline (PGAP) service were manually edited in the genome.

canonical_statement: The complete LI021 genome was a 2,216,765-bp circular chromosome deposited as GenBank CP046590.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The complete 2,216,765 bp circular chromosome of LI021 (GenBank accession number CP046590) ...

canonical_statement: Strain LI021 belonged to sequence type ST75, which the authors described as unique at the time.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Strain LI021 belonged to a currently so far unique sequence type ST75

canonical_statement: LI021 carried mecB in a novel 22,636-bp pseudo-SCCmec element (ΨSCCmecBLI021) downstream of orfX (rlmH).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: carried the mecB gene in a novel 22,636 bp pseudo (Ψ) SCCmec element (ΨSCCmecBLI021) downstream of the orfX (rlmH) gene

canonical_statement: The mecB gene was located in an operon containing mecR1m and mecIm but lacking blaZm.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The mecB gene was located in an operon that contains the regulators mecR1m and mecIm but lacks the blaZm gene.

canonical_statement: ΨSCCmecBLI021 shared 99% nucleotide identity with ΨSCCmec of Epi0076A across an 8,290-bp region containing mecB.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The ΨSCCmecBLI021 shares high nucleotide identity (99%) to ΨSCCmec of Epi0076A in the 8290-bp region containing the mecB gene

canonical_statement: Downstream of ΨSCCmecBLI021, additional SCC integration sites segmented the region into pseudo-SCC subunits of 3,553 bp, 2,000 bp, and 24,592 bp.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: three additional integration site sequences for SCC (ISS) segmented the region into ΨSCC subunits of 3553-bp (ISS3 to ISS4), 2000-bp (ISS4 to ISS5) and 24,592-bp (ISS5 to ISS6).

canonical_statement: LI021 carried putative hlgB and hlgC gamma-hemolysin genes at the 3-prime end of the SCC array, which the authors stated were likely responsible for the observed beta-hemolysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: LI021 carries putative γ-hemolysin genes (hlgB and hlgC) (Fig. 1), which are likely to be responsible for the β-hemolysis observed on the blood plates.

canonical_statement: Figure 1 uses gray connections to denote regions with 83% to 100% nucleotide sequence identity among the compared SCCmecB structures.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Gray connections between the structures indicate regions with between 83% and 100% nucleotide sequence identity.

canonical_statement: Figure 1 compares SCCmecB structures from M. canis strains KM45013T, LI021, and Epi0076A and shows multiple homologous fragments across the elements.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The comparison was generated with Easyfig software ... using sequences of M. canis strains KM45013T ... LI021 ... and Epi0076A ... Gray connections between the structures indicate regions with between 83% and 100% nucleotide sequence identity.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that the human skin infection was associated with M. canis and stated that the organism probably originated from a dog.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The skin infection in a human patient described here was associated with M.canis which probably originated from a dog.

canonical_statement: No samples could be collected from the two dogs living in the patient’s household, so a canine source was not directly tested.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Unfortunately, no samples could be collected from the dogs living in the same household.

canonical_statement: Because the lesion swab produced polymicrobial growth including A. ursingii and E. faecalis, the source does not establish that M. canis alone caused the patient’s skin syndrome.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MALDI-TOF MS identified Acinetobacter ursingii and Enterococcus faecalis within the polymicrobial growth, but not the predominant β-hemolytic colonies.

canonical_statement: The authors argued that more attention should be paid to Macrococcus as a new emerging opportunistic pathogen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: emphasizes that more attention should be paid to Macrococcus as a new emerging opportunistic pathogen.

canonical_statement: The complete genome of M. canis strain LI021 was deposited in GenBank under accession CP046590.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The complete genome of M. canis strain LI021 has been deposited into the GenBank under accession number CP046590.
